title: Michele Sindona's money laundering operation
summary: JASON tells of Michele Sindona's money laundering operation, about 1964 at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And it's used to do the world's biggest money laundering operation ever, 200 billion dollars according to the author Paul Williams.

plain: On a 2026 episode of Jesse Michels's podcast, a speaker named Jason describes a money laundering operation tied to a financier named Michele Sindona, starting around 1964. Citing the author Paul Williams, he says it was the biggest money laundering operation ever, about 200 billion dollars, and he links it to other names including James Jesus Angleton and Charles Hambro. He tells it as part of an argument that secret money and secret networks sit behind the hiding of UFO knowledge.
